metadata.title: FitKarma — India's AI-powered Fitness and Wellness Ecosystem
metadata.description: FitKarma is India's dedicated AI health intelligence platform, featuring culturally attuned nutrition logging, Daily Intelligence Packages, and a capped 1,000-seat VIP Beta cohort.
metadata.keywords: FitKarma, Indian fitness, AI health intelligence, Indian meal tracker, roti katori calories, wellness ecosystem

common.tagline: India's AI-powered Fitness and Wellness Ecosystem

hero.title: Health Intelligence Built for Indian Lifestyles
hero.subtitle: Explore our core capabilities on the right — the interactive simulation on the left stays fixed and adapts to whatever feature you are viewing.

nutrition.title: Built for Indian Household Portions, Not Generic Grams
nutrition.description: Standard fitness apps demand gram scales, completely breaking down when faced with Indian home cooking. FitKarma is built around the authentic ways Indian families cook, serve, and eat.
nutrition.point1_desc: Tracks roti count with a single-tap Desi Ghee toggle, factoring in healthy lipid density (+45 kcal) without altering carb totals.
nutrition.point2_desc: Measures dal, rice, and subzis in standard 150ml household katoris rather than confusing weight scales.
nutrition.point3_desc: Captures the reality of Indian tempering — from minimal home-style oil to rich festive preparations.
nutrition.point4_desc: Instantly switch between authentic North, South, Bengali, and Western Indian dietary baselines.
nutrition.interactive_hint: ← Try adjusting the sliders on the left device to see instant live macro recalculations.

dip.title: Daily Intelligence Package (DIP): Timely Pulses, Not Endless Counting
dip.description: Instead of passive calorie counting and anxiety-inducing alerts, FitKarma provides 3 curated contextual pulses aligned with your metabolic circadian rhythm.
dip.point1_desc: Sleep architecture score, resting heart rate, and high-protein breakfast prompts (e.g. Moong dal chilla) to steady midday glucose.
dip.point2_desc: Hydration tracking and a 10-minute post-prandial stroll prompt to flatten post-lunch glucose spikes.
dip.point3_desc: Daily Karma score, restorative wind-down schedule, and warm turmeric latte recommendations.
dip.point4_desc: Evolves with your schedule rather than forcing rigid, unrealistic dietary regimes.
dip.interactive_hint: ← Switch between Morning, Midday, and Evening tabs on the left to preview contextual intelligence.

scanner.title: 3D AI Food Scanner: Camera Intelligence for Home Cooking
scanner.description: Mixed gravies, composite thalis, and home-cooked dishes confuse generic barcode scanners. FitKarma uses proprietary multi-component computer vision trained on 2,500+ Indian culinary recipes.
scanner.point1_desc: Simultaneously identifies rotis, dal, subzi, and rice on a single plate with bounding-box certainty.
scanner.point2_desc: Estimates portion volume and lipid density right from the camera frame without manual lookups.
scanner.point3_desc: Adds composite plates directly to your Daily Karma record in under 2 seconds.
scanner.point4_desc: Recognizes complex home meals from Dosas and Sambar to Dal Makhani and Biryanis.
scanner.interactive_hint: ← Click the shutter button on the 3D phone to your left to simulate real-time AI food recognition.

hero.description: From accurate roti and katori portion tracking to contextual morning-to-night health nudges. Experience India's first metabolic intelligence ecosystem built from the ground up for our food, biology, and habits.

meal_sandbox.title: Indian Meal Sandbox
meal_sandbox.desc: Adjust rotis, katoris, and tadka intensity to see real-time macro calculations adapted to actual Indian home cooking.

north.title: North Indian Thali
north.desc: Phulkas with desi ghee, slow-simmered dal tadka, fresh paneer bhurji, dahi, and kachumber.

south.title: South Indian Thali
south.desc: Traditional steamed Ponni rice, drumstick sambar, pepper rasam, beetroot poriyal, and fresh curd.

bengali.title: Bengali Thali
bengali.desc: Aromatic Gobindobhog rice, sweet-spiced cholar dal, classic aloo posto, and light tomato chutney.

western.title: Western (Gujarati/Maharashtrian) Thali
western.desc: Soft thin rotlis, khatti-meethi dal or amti, sev tameta, comforting kadhi, and chilled chaas.

insight.title: Why Indian Household Portions Matter
insight.description: Standard calorie counters fail because a katori of dal varies by 100+ kcal depending on whether the tadka is home-style or dhaba-style. FitKarma captures these exact culinary nuances.

dip.title: Daily Intelligence Package (DIP)
dip.subtitle: Contextual circadian health intelligence delivered at pivotal metabolic moments throughout your day.

morning.label: 07:00 Morning Readiness
morning.title: Circadian Morning Readiness
morning.insight: High sleep architecture score (86%). Your metabolic focus peak is projected between 08:30 and 10:30 AM.
morning.action: Suggested: High-protein breakfast (Moong Dal Chilla or Boiled Eggs) to steady midday glucose.

midday.label: 13:30 Midday Nudge
midday.title: Post-Lunch Glucose & Energy Pulse
midday.insight: Moderate glycemic load detected from lunch. A brief 10-minute leisurely stroll attenuates post-prandial glucose spike by ~22%.
midday.action: Suggested: Take a 10-minute post-lunch walk before resuming screen work.

evening.label: 21:00 Evening Debrief
evening.title: Night Recovery & Wind-Down
evening.insight: Daily macro balance achieved at 94%. Your natural melatonin secretion window initiates in approximately 45 minutes.
evening.action: Suggested: Dim overhead blue lights; enjoy warm turmeric milk or chamomile infusion.
